scientific_question: Does the rank-16 correction rejected in v180 become sufficient when its diagonal whitening and spectral correction are generated separately from each deployment-visible reported geometry, with the rank, data, exact-call shell, K0/K1 replay, and accuracy gates otherwise unchanged?
role: post-open mechanism diagnostic on the same four already-open p22-s01 frames; the complete p22 trajectory remains excluded from every affine-basis statistic, geometry factor, rank choice, fallback, and stopping rule

causal_interpretation.primary_pass: supports geometry dependence, rather than rank-16 correction capacity alone, as the explanation for the v180 shared-map failure
causal_interpretation.primary_fail: shows that this fixed Jacobi-whitened rank-16 geometry factor is insufficient even after geometry conditioning; it does not prove that all geometry-conditioned or nonlinear compact mechanisms are impossible
what_is_held_fixed: the thirteen calibrations and frozen five-camera subsets
the K0 and unchanged physical CGLS K1 arms
all absolute field, gradient, and observation gates

data_isolation.affine_fit_source: exactly the ten complete train-split trajectories and 1010 transformed fields inherited through v178-v180
data_isolation.geometry_factor_source: reported calibration, active-camera subset, frozen affine basis, and the resulting straight-ray measurement matrix only
data_isolation.heldout_source: exactly p=22kw_size=01 with only frame indices 0,25,75,100 already opened through v179-v180
heldout_truth_forbidden_from: whitened eigensystem and selected rank-16 modes
heldout_truth_allowed_only_for: synthetic observation generation through the frozen forward operator
final field and gradient scoring after every observation-only candidate is sealed

affine_representation.definition: rebuild the v178-v180 arithmetic fit mean and direct thin-SVD basis from the same 1010 fit fields
affine_representation.sign_canonicalization: largest-absolute field entry is nonnegative; ties use the lowest flat index

geometry_conditioned_factor.name: jacobi_whitened_normal_rank16_inverse
geometry_conditioned_factor.measurement_matrix: M_c=A_c U^T for the current reported calibration and active-camera set
geometry_conditioned_factor.jacobi_diagonal: D_c=diag(H_c); every entry must be finite and greater than 1e-30 or execution is inconclusive
geometry_conditioned_factor.whitened_normal: K_c=D_c^(-1/2) H_c D_c^(-1/2), explicitly symmetrized before a full symmetric eigendecomposition
geometry_conditioned_factor.eigensolver: scipy.linalg.eigh with driver=evd; eigenvalues are sorted ascending and must be strictly positive without a numerical floor
geometry_conditioned_factor.mode_selection: retain exactly the 16 largest mode scores; ties use lower eigenvalue and then lower original ascending eigen-index
geometry_conditioned_factor.eigenvector_sign: the largest-absolute entry is nonnegative; ties use the lowest coordinate index
geometry_conditioned_factor.primary_action: for g=U A_c^T(y-A_c mean_fit), let h=D_c^(-1/2)g and return a=D_c^(-1/2)[h+V_r diag(1/lambda_r-1)V_r^T h]
geometry_conditioned_factor.fallback: none; any non-finite diagonal, non-positive eigenvalue, eigensolver failure, rank failure, or replay failure makes the run inconclusive

geometry_jacobi_inverse.definition: the same exact-adjoint coordinate feature and geometry-specific Jacobi diagonal, without any spectral correction

affine_coordinate_cgls1.definition: from mean_fit compute raw g, one exact projected forward M g, beta=(g^Tg)/((Mg)^T(Mg)), and a=beta*g with denominator floor 1e-30

fit_mean.definition: the immutable fit mean before and after one unchanged physical CGLS K1 step

v180_shared_rank16_parent.definition: the frozen v180 shared diagonal-plus-rank-16 result is inherited as a negative parent and is not refitted or reselected

evaluation.primary: geometry_rank16_k0 and geometry_rank16_k1 on both frozen five-camera and all-nine arms
evaluation.physical_k1_rule: one unmodified identity-preconditioned CGLS step from the supplied field using the exact current residual; denominator floor 1e-30
evaluation.subset_rule: reuse the immutable minimal_shared_gram_ridge five-camera subset frozen before p22 truth was opened in v176

frozen_operator.forward: the calibrated exact-adjoint straight-ray density-gradient proxy inherited from v176-v180

exact_call_and_cache_ledger.truth_observation: one excluded offline forward per sensor arm, calibration, and frame
exact_call_and_cache_ledger.resource_claim: none; the 26260 geometry-cache projections make v181 a mechanism-capacity audit rather than a deployable resource result

required_validity_gates: all v180 parent identities, statuses, audit, decision, arrays, and input trees remain unchanged
all fit, p22, calibration, subset, selection, and source trees remain unchanged
affine rank is exactly 1009 and basis orthogonality is within 1e-7
all 26 measurement and geometry factors are sealed before heldout field loading
every Jacobi diagonal is finite and greater than 1e-30
every whitened normal eigensystem is finite, strictly positive, reconstructs within 1e-10, and retains exactly 16 canonical modes
factor construction and prediction APIs have no truth parameter
fixed-observation heldout-truth mutation leaves every coordinate and field candidate byte-identical
camera permutation changes the normal matrix, factor, coordinates, and fields by at most 1e-10
all exact-call, mean-cache, factor-construction, and offline-scoring receipts equal the frozen ledger
formal and input trees remain unchanged
independent second implementation passes every required comparison

must_independently_rebuild: the ten fit input identities, 1010 fields, fit mean, 1009-direction affine basis, and sign convention
the thirteen calibrations, frozen five-camera selections, all-nine operators, and all 26 measurement matrices
every Jacobi diagonal, whitened normal, eigensystem, deterministic rank-16 mode selection, canonical factor, and geometry-only diagnostic
all deployment exact-adjoint features and geometry-rank16, Jacobi, coordinate-CGLS, and mean candidates before reading formal candidate arrays
physical K0/K1 replay, all 832 metric rows, exact-call/cache receipts, calibration and frame tails, control dominance, and decision

decision_order: Any identity, isolation, affine-basis, geometry-factor, eigensystem, rank, observation-only, mutation, permutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v181 inconclusive.
If the geometry-conditioned rank-16 primary K0 or K1 fails both sensor arms, conclude FAIL_GEOMETRY_CONDITIONED_RANK16_INVERSE_V181 and close this fixed Jacobi-whitened rank-16 factorization.
If the primary passes all-nine but fails the frozen five-camera arm, conclude FAIL_FIVE_CAMERA_GEOMETRY_CONDITIONED_RANK16_INVERSE_V181.
If the primary passes five-camera but fails all-nine, conclude FAIL_VARIABLE_CARDINALITY_GEOMETRY_CONDITIONED_RANK16_INVERSE_V181.
If fit mean K0 and K1 pass both sensor arms, prefer the fixed prior and reject the primary advantage.
If affine-coordinate CGLS1 K0 and K1 pass both sensor arms, prefer the deterministic projected-gradient control and reject the primary advantage.
If geometry-Jacobi K0 and K1 pass both sensor arms, prefer the rank-zero geometry factor and reject rank-16 necessity.
Only if geometry-rank16 K0 and K1 pass both sensor arms while all three cheaper controls fail may v181 conclude PASS_GEOMETRY_CONDITIONED_RANK16_HEADROOM_V181.
No v181 outcome is a learned algorithm, external generalization result, exact-call reduction result, wall/RSS result, curved-ray result, real BOST result, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
